answer_1.quote: First, we ask the model to provide a summary of the relevant political party. Secondly, we ask the model to speculate the party's stance related to the political statement in question. Lastly, we ask the model to answer the question in light of the 2 preceding question-answers pairs.
answer_1.outputs: Generated summaries of political parties, opinions on political statements, and answers to questions about party stances.

answer_2.quote: We measure models' performance using accuracy, i.e., the percentage of questions where the model generates the same answer as the examined party.
